pages.description: The musician and actor on being stranded alone in Mexico and why travelling with her band is like being part of a circus.
pages.text: Musician Kate Nash on Her Irish Heritage and the Reality of Touring | National Geographic TRAVEL Musician Kate Nash on Her Irish Heritage and the Reality of Touring The musician and actor on being stranded alone in Mexico and why travelling with her band is like being part of a circus. Kate Nash is a singer, songwriter and actress from London. Ellius Grace As told to Flora Neighbour Published November 15, 2026 This article was produced by National Geographic Traveller (U K). Flora Neighbour: Your new album is influenced by your Irish heritage. Did a particular place inspire one of the songs? Kate Nash: My family are from Galway, Sligo and Cavan, so I really wanted to explore these places in my artistry. But the track Christmas Eve is actually about my granny and grandad meeting on O’Connell Street in Dublin on Christmas Eve. I’ll always have an affinity with Dublin as that’s where their journey started. FN: What do you hope people will take from the album? KN: It’s quite a dense record, with some heavy topics, but I want it to be empowering. I also hope that people feel a lot of happiness. Irish music is innately joyful, so I hope it’s uplifting to listen to as well as quite emotional. Nowadays, people are much more open to exploring their heritage, so I think now’s the right time to release this music. FN: Where should everyone visit while in Ireland? KN: I’d send people to the west coast and tell them to drive up the Wild Atlantic Way. Visit Spiddal in Galway, as it has great places to eat and drink. Construction of the $100bn (£73bn) project - named Starbase, Louisiana - is due to start next year, with the 125,000-acre (50,585-hectare) site expanding on the company's operations beyond its current Texas headquarters and locations in Florida. It will be used to "support thousands of Starship flights a year with missions launching to Earth orbit, the Moon, Mars and beyond," SpaceX said on Tuesday. In June, SpaceX shares started trading on New York's technology-focused Nasdaq in the world's biggest ever stock market debut . SpaceX said it aims to launch its first Starship flight from the new Louisiana base in 2029. The facility will add more than 3,000 jobs to the region, the company said . pages.text: My sleepless night in a chimpanzee nest | National Geographic ANIMALS My sleepless night in a chimpanzee nest Unraveling the mystery of human evolution, thirty-five feet in the air. A chimpanzee female ( Pan troglodytes schweinfurthii ) sleeps in a nest built in a tree in Uganda's Kibale National Park. The origins of human evolution might lie, in part, in the ancient transition from dozing in trees to snuggling in a group on the ground. Eric Baccega, Nature Picture Library By Robert Moor Published April 7, 2026 One night in the sparse forests of eastern Tanzania , I stood in the viridian twilight and watched a troop of chimpanzees make their beds. Standing in a tangle of underbrush, I listened to the sounds of rustling as the dark, distant bodies deftly wove their nests, rapidly bending and tucking the springy branches—a flurry of haphazard-looking movement that resulted, within minutes, in something startlingly intricate, much as a magician’s frantic gestures give birth ( et voilà! ) to a balloon animal. I was visiting the research camp, known as the Greater Mahale Ecosystem Research and Conservation area (GMERC), which was run by a primatologist named Fiona Stewart. Among her colleagues, Stewart was revered for an audacious series of experiments she once conducted in Fongoli, Senegal. Curious to know why chimpanzees prefer to sleep in nests, she spent five full nights sleeping in a chimpanzee nest. pages.text: Mykhailo Mudryk: Ukrainian Association of Football blamed for failed drugs test - BBC Sport Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Mudryk joined Chelsea in a deal worth up to £89m in January 2023 By Nizaar Kinsella Football reporter Published 18 November 2026 On-loan Tottenham winger Mykhailo Mudryk says he blames the administration of the Ukraine national team for his failed drugs test and subsequent ban from football. The 25-year-old, on a season-long loan from Chelsea , was suspended from November 2024 until July 2026 after testing positive for the banned substance meldonium, which he believes entered his system while on international duty. Having initially faced a four-year ban from the Football Association (FA), his appeal to the Court of Arbitration for Sport was successful. He returned to football after accepting he had breached anti-doping rules and agreeing to a suspension equivalent to the time he had already served. After appearing for Chelsea during a pre-season tour of Asia, Mudryk joined Tottenham on transfer deadline day to reunite with his former Shakhtar Donetsk manager Roberto de Zerbi. In a lengthy interview with the Ukrainian YouTube channel Guest of Gordon, Mudryk was asked who he blamed for his absence from the game. "The environment, the situation in the Ukrainian national team," he replied. "It should never have existed. I probably haven't said it publicly yet, but I'm saying it now. NAAQS Table The Clean Air Act , which was last amended in 1990, requires EPA to set National Ambient Air Quality Standards (40 CFR part 50) for six principal pollutants ( "criteria" air pollutants ) which can be harmful to public health and the environment. The Clean Air Act identifies two types of national ambient air quality standards. Primary standards provide public health protection, including protecting the health of "sensitive" populations such as asthmatics, children, and the elderly. Secondary standards provide public welfare protection, including protection against decreased visibility and damage to animals, crops, vegetation, and buildings. Periodically, the standards are reviewed and sometimes may be revised, establishing new standards. The most recently established standards are listed below. In some areas of the U.S., certain regulatory requirements may also remain for implementation of previously established standards . Units of measure for the standards are parts per million (ppm) by volume, parts per billion (ppb) by volume, and micrograms per cubic meter of air (µg/m 3 ). Un nuevo informe de la UNESCO y el University College London, presentado en la COP31, revela que los modelos de inteligencia artificial responden correctamente al 90 % de las preguntas sobre el clima, pero abandonan rápidamente los datos científicos cuando los usuarios los cuestionan. Esto es una advertencia para los responsables políticos e investigadores que barajan el uso de la IA para el desarrollo de políticas climáticas. La precisión también varía considerablemente entre los trece idiomas analizados, lo que refleja las diferencias en los datos de entrenamiento disponibles, con mejores resultados en inglés, francés, español y portugués, y peores en idiomas como el hindi, el urdu y el swahili. En ocho de cada diez ocasiones, los modelos cambiaban de opinión ante el más mínimo indicio de desacuerdo por parte del usuario, lo que confirmaba errores alarmantes como "el CO₂ no es el principal factor del cambio climático". Each North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code identifies an industry and has a corresponding receipts-based or employee-based small business size standard. In a small business set-aside procurement, the contracting officer designates the applicable NAICS code, whose size standard the awardee must meet. Any offeror or other interested party adversely affected by the designated NAICS code may appeal that NAICS code to OHA. 13 C.F.R. 121.402 & 121.1102. Time limits for filing an appeal You must file your NAICS appeal with OHA within 10 calendar days of the issuance of the solicitation or within 10 calendar days of the issuance of the amendment if the appeal relates to an amendment affecting the NAICS code, 13 C.F.R. 134.304(a)(3) . Nanotyrannus lancensis, which recent findings suggest was a distinct dinosaur and not a young Tyrannosaurus rex , was a small-sized Late Cretaceous predator that may have competed with juvenile T.rex for food. Andrey Atuchin, Cleveland Museum of Natural History By Riley Black Published December 4, 2025 Nipping at the heels of a landmark study from October that crowned the short king Nanotyrannus as a legitimate dinosaur, a second team of paleontologists has independently reached the same conclusion: the tiny carnivore was no teen Tyrannosaurus rex but its own distinct species. The new research, published Thursday in Science , comes from an analysis of a small throat bone of the very specimen that set off the decades-old debate. By studying the microscopic details of a peculiar part of the hyoid, called the ceratobranchial, which change with age and comparing it with bones from other animals, such as ostriches, alligators, T. rex , and Allosaurus , the researchers could estimate how mature it was. Their analysis indicated that the fossil was an adult, not a teenager.
